ownership.grant_rule: Set true only when Wood Splitter adds previously absent Axeman.
ownership.revoke_rule: Remove Axeman only when Wood Splitter is absent and the provenance key is true.
ownership.idempotence: Trait membership is set-like; repeated reconciliation neither duplicates nor stacks.
ownership.save_compatibility: Existing saves reconcile on OnCreatePlayer; provenance persists in player modData; no migration file is required.
ownership.multiplayer: DisabledInMultiplayer remains true for character selection; migrated/admin cases and network ordering remain in-game-unproven.

definition.nonstacking: Wood Splitter and Axeman are selection-exclusive; legacy/admin coexistence still produces one Axeman membership.
